chapter_title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers
spiritual_reading:
# The Five Degrees of Divine Proceeding — Spiritual Translation

---

** ¶2:** Five originating principles of the Divine exist, each proceeding from the one before it. One flows forth from another in successive degrees.

**¶3:** The first orig inating principle is the Divine Good itself — infinite love, glory beyond measure — the sole origin , eternal before all states that have been or shall be. It contains within itself all five degrees of its own proceeding forever. It is prior to every created state , every un fol ding that exists or will exist.

**¶4:** From this Divine Good, three powers proceed. The first is the Divine Truth in its universal form — the first proce eding, which may be called the Mother, because it is the receiving and form ative principle born from the Divine Good. It appeared first.

**¶5 :** The second is the Divine Love made manifest in the sphere of all wisdom — the love that is honored above all other aff ections, proce eding directly from the Divine Good and becoming visible through it .

**¶6:** The third is the Divine Wisdom in its operative and medi ating function — the eldest of all counsel ing principles — proce eding from the first Good into active governance . It appeared .

**¶7:** This is the first originating good, the first power, from which three great capacities of the Divine proceed. This is the first eternal principle , the root of all wisdom and all illumin ation. And from it these three proceedings have conquered all falsity, have brought to nothing the ruling love of evil, and have established dominion for themselves and for all the states of heavenly life that belong to them .

**¶8:** The second orig inating principle , which proceeds from the first, is this operative Divine Wisdom — formed after the pattern of the Divine Good itself. And from it, too , three powers are called forth and sent.

**¶9:** The first is the sustaining order of divine truth in its complete human form — the Perfect Human — which upholds all things from beneath , the great supporting structure, the bearing principle greater than all other bearing principles. (* The Pillar as correspondence sign ifies the truth of divine order that holds all lesser truths in their place; the Perfect Man sign ifies the Divine Human form through which all things are sustained. *)

**¶10:** The second is saving wisdom made rad iant — the spl endor of divine truth through which eternal life is given to all who receive it.

**¶11:** The third is the pure affection for truth, which is the love of wisdom in its virg inal state — the in most de light in knowing what is true. By its very appearance it disarms the ruling falsities and the dominating evils, drawing away their power , because it fulf ills the in most purpose of the Divine.

** ¶12:** The third originating principle proceeds from the second: it is this saving wisdom, the radiance of divine truth itself . And from it also three callings -forth proceed, after the same pattern as before .

**¶13:** The first power called forth is the illuminated understanding — interior perception opened and filled with the light of the Divine.

**¶14:** The second power called forth is the disc erning principle of divine truth, which separates and distingu ishes all states of the human soul. Its operation is established in the intermediate realm between the celest ial and the natural — among the revol ving states and the kn owledges of truth and good . (*The atmosphere corresponds to the intermediate spiritual states; the wheel and stars correspond to the cycles of spiritual progression and the knowledges of truth . *)

**¶16:** The fourth originating principle is this illuminated understanding itself . And from it, too, three powers proceed, after the pattern of saving wisdom.

**¶20:** And the fifth originating principle is the spiritual form of light itself — the very form that shall appear to every soul when it departs from the natural state of the body. And three great lumin ous ministers of divine truth accompany it.

** ¶21:** One bears in his hand the good of life that has been attained — the prize of regener ation. The second bears the garment of external truths that will clothe the spirit in its new state. The third possesses the d iadem of love , the wreath of intelligence , and the crown of wisdom. These are the three ministers of wisdom that accompany this spiritual form when it meets the depar ting soul.

**¶22 :** These are the five degrees of divine proceeding, each flowing forth from the one before it . They have appeared and become manifest through one another — for the Divine Good reaches the individual soul only by proce eding through successive degrees: from infinite love, through universal truth , through operative wisdom, through saving rad iance, through illuminated understanding, and at last into the very spiritual form that gr eets each person at the threshold of eternal life.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five fathers exist; they were summoned forth one of one. [Also], one did come out of another!

The first Father is the Father of Greatness, the blessed one of glory, the [on]e who has no measure to his greatness; who also is the first only-begotten, the first eternal; who exists with fiv[e fa]thers for ever; the one who exists before every thing that has existed, and that will exist.
Now he, the glorious Father, summoned from him three emanations. The [fi]rst is the Gre[at] Spirit, the first Mother, who came out of the Father. She appeared first.
The seco[nd i]s the Belo[ved of] the Lights, the great glorious Beloved, [the one w]ho is honour[ed; w]ho came out of the Father. [He ma]nifested ou[t of h]im.
The third father is the Thir[d Ambassador], the eldest of [all] the counsell[ors; who came out of] the first Father. He appeared.

This is the first Father, the first power, the one from whom the three great powers came out. This is the first Father, the first eternal, the root of all the lights; from whom the three emanations came out. They have humiliated the Darkness. They have brought its heart's desire to naught. They have given themselves the victory. They have also given the victory to their aeons.
The second father, who came out of the first Father, is the Third Ambassador, the model of the King of lights. And again, he too summoned and sent out of him three powers.
One is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man; the one who bears up under all things; the great Pillar of blessing; the great porter, who is greater than all the porters.
The second is glorious Jesus the Splendour; [the] one through whom shall be given life eternal.
The third is the Virgin of Light, the glorious wisd[o]m; the one who takes away the heart of the [rul]ers and the powers by her image, as she fulfils the pleas[u]re of the greatness.
The third father, who came out of the second father: he is glorious Jesus the Splendour. And, again, he too summoned three evocations after the pattern of the second father.
The first power whom he summoned is the Light Min[d].

The second power whom Jesus summo[n]ed is the gre[at Jud]ge, who gives judgement on all the souls of mankind, [his] dwelling being established in the atmosphere under [the firmament and the] wheel [of the] stars.
The third power is [the Y]outh, the gre[at living] light in his two persons, in [the call and the answer], I am speaking about that which has been established in the summons [and] the obedience.
The fourth father is the Light Mind. And, again, he too summoned three powers after the pattern of Jesus.
And also the fifth father is this Light Form; the one who shall appear to everyone who will go out from his body; and the thr[ee] great glorious angels who are come with her.
These are the five fathers who have come out of one another. They have appeared and man[ifes]ted through one another!
